It’s time for Star Wars Speeder Bike One-Ball Bike, PART 2. You can check out part 1 to see what happened so far – yes it’s one-ball balancing robot that I can ride on. Importantly it’s actually balancing on the ball in all directions which makes it Holonomic – so it can move in any direction at any time, so not just a ball shaped wheel with an axle though it.
